41/S0.subgoal: Introduce the Majuli VR tour case study and the design principles it applies.

41/S1.subgoal: Describe the design objectives and broad considerations for the Majuli VR tour.

41/S2.subgoal: Describe the iterative development process and the use of user feedback in the design lifecycle.

41/S3.subgoal: Explain how user categories and points of interest are identified to cater to diverse user preferences.

41/S4.subgoal: Describe the design of the tour's starting point and the pre-processing of media assets for a better user experience.

41/S5.subgoal: Describe the design of the virtual tablet interface and its interaction features.

41/S6.subgoal: Explain how mini-maps and global maps provide orientation awareness and wayfinding support.

41/S7.subgoal: Describe the techniques used for smooth navigation transitions and long-distance exploration.

41/S8.subgoal: Explain how the system provides access to relevant content and information at specific locations.

41/S9.subgoal: Explain the design choices made to minimize cyber sickness during exploration.

41/S10.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
